description.text: Teaching ObjectivesTo help student obtain knowledge and ability of business management, economic management and enterprise management, and enable student to deal with all kinds of business management related work in all kinds of organizations.Main Courses Principles of Management,micro-economics,macro-economics,Management Information System,Statistics, Marketing,Economic Law, Human Resource Management,Enterprise Strategic Management, Finance ManagementInternship Human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise.Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Business Administration (BBA) .Future Career Graduates can engage in the field of human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise.

duration.text: The Business Administration at Wuhan University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: The first page of a regular individual passport (valid until at least December 2025) and the visa page for China (if any)High school diploma or pre-graduation certificate (in Chinese or English)High school transcript (in Chinese or English)HSK test scores (only for programs taught in Chinese)Proof of personal financial capacity or financial guarantee (5,000 US dollars or more)Proof of English proficiency such as TOEFL or IELTS (only for English-taught programs)Applicants who are already in China and have studied there are required to provide a statement of their academic performance issued by their previous institutionsA physical examination report within 6 months (the original must be submitted at the time of registration and reporting for admission)

requirements.text: 1.Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens and meet the requirements stipulated in the Ministry of Education's Document No. 12 of 2020. The applicant is in good physical and mental health and willing to abide by the laws and regulations of China as well as the rules and regulations of Wuhan University.2. Applicants must be between 18 and 25 years old, with age calculated as of September 1st of the year of enrollment. Applicants under the age of 18 must submit a guardian's guarantee letter at the time of application.3. Language proficiencyApplicants for Chinese-taught courses must have a Chinese proficiency of 180 points (inclusive) or above on the New HSK Level 4. Applicants whose native language is Chinese or who were taught in Chinese during high school, upon recognition by our school, may be exempted from providing HSK scores.Applicants for courses taught in English are required to have an English proficiency of TOEFL 80+, TOEFL Essential 8+ or IELTS 6.0+. Applicants whose native language is English or whose previous academic qualifications were taught in English, upon recognition by our university, may be exempted from providing TOEFL and IELTS scores
